# E0607: the CUE module requires a version of thema's CUE newer than the one this program embeds

The cue.mod/module.cue above the lineage depends on a version of thema's
CUE module newer than the one this program embeds. thema's CLI resolves
github.com/sdboyer/thema to its own embedded copy, which serves a module
requiring that version or an older one; the help names the newest version to
declare.

## Example

`mod/cue.mod/module.cue`:

```cue
module: "example.com/skew"
language: version: "v0.9.0"
deps: "github.com/sdboyer/thema@v0": {v: "v0.999.0"}
```

`mod/x.cue`:

```cue
package x

import "github.com/sdboyer/thema"

lin: thema.Lineage & {
	name: "x"
	schemas: {
		"0": {
			"0": {
				schema: {
					a: string
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
```

`data.json`:

```json
{"a": "Argo"}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0607]: the CUE module requires thema v0.999.0, newer than the v0.2.2 this program embeds
 --> mod/x.cue:3:8
  |
3 | import "github.com/sdboyer/thema"
  |        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  |
  = help: use a thema at v0.999.0 or newer, or require v0.2.2 or older of github.com/sdboyer/thema@v0 in each cue.mod/module.cue that requires v0.999.0
```
